editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: CMC Markets is a legitimate, FCA-regulated broker with 35+ years of operation and LSE listing since 2016. NAFT scores it 8.1/10 for 2026 — strong regulation across four Tier-1 jurisdictions, same-day withdrawal processing, and one of the deepest instrument ranges in retail trading. The 0.7 pip EUR/USD spread on Standard is fair but not class-leading. Watch for the GBP 10/month inactivity fee and the opaque FX Active commission structure. A solid choice for intermediate-to-advanced traders who value platform depth over rock-bottom costs.
